question: Under profile enhanced and the KiCad plugin's default options, on the plugin's default board input (kicad_pcb), does `router.pour_fill_target=true` (the maze search reaches a .kicad_pcb signal-layer pour only in the core of its opened fill, and the cycle rule keeps a trace with both ends in such a pour only as a bridge into the fill) lower KiCad's unconnected count after `--refill-zones`, summed over the registered boards, by more than the set's noise, with no routing-caused manufacturing breach or below-minimum copper in any arm, routing-caused DRC not up in total, no board worse than its own noise band and the route time at most 25 % more in total, so that it joins the ENHANCED table?
noise_why: K15.14's noise, unchanged, and it applies here: the rule is the same (routing-quality.md's totals rule for a change to profile enhanced: accept when the total improves by more than the set's noise, sqrt(sum of the per-board bands squared)) and so are the rows and boards. canary-pwr's band is its registered 10 (docs/roadmap/prereg/K09.json `noise.canary-pwr`, N02's variant spread, as K14.json and K15.14), a constant of the rule and not a property of this engine. Every other board takes the rule's default max(2, ceil(5 % of its connections)), with `connections` the router's `board_statistics.connections.maximum_count` from the arm's result manifest (gate_totals.rs `default_band`), the larger of the two arms as the gate takes it: a count of the board as loaded, not of a route, so the setting and the engine changes since K15.14's run (K15.12, K15.18, K15.22, K15.23, K15.25) do not move it. Nothing of this set was run to derive it. From K15.14's amendment-3 records (target/orchestrator/k1514/out/records.json, the same boards) the bands are pcu-76163c7 43, canary-pwr-95882f00 10, interf_u 11, pic_programmer 7, kit-dev-coldfire-xilinx_5213 28, complex_hierarchy 14, loratracker-hardware-loratracker-hat 12, m-fc-g474-rev-a-m-fc 14, macroprocessor-diode-matrix-rom-dip 8, moteus-moteus-c1 22, nudac-nudac 9, openmuscle-flexgrid-om-flexgrid-rigid-pcb 8, pcie-active-backplane-pcie-active-backplane-x16-4layer 14, pocketsdr-v3-0 27, solarmeshtasticnode-meshtasticnode-bq25185 6, vna-usb-pd 4, wisweep-driver-board 11: a set noise of 72.32 over all 17 rows and 67.09 over the 16 without pocketsdr-v3-0 (K15.14's gate printed 67.09); the gate recomputes them from this run's records. helper.what: K15.14's helper, unchanged (the same sha256 as K15.14's `helper`): `prepare` (the boards, from `boards`), `run` (the registration's `commands`, verbatim) and `collect` (records.json for the gate and table.md, from the arms each row's `commands` lists and the registered `metrics`); nothing in it names K15.14's flag or arms. `collect` also computes K15.13's pour-guard count, which is not a registered metric here and so is not recorded; table.md's 'pours guarded' column is 0 in every arm and is not read

grading: per row, pcb-off then pcb-on; pcb-on with SHARE_GRADE_WITH its pcb-off arm, so a session byte-identical to the baseline's copies its grade (summary grade_shared_with). Under the board's own rules (rules = project: the row's .kicad_pro and .kicad_dru, hashed in rules_files), the same oracle, metrics and manufacturing types as K13.6, K14.6 and K15.14. kicad-cli only while `pgrep -x kicad-cli` shows none, one job at a time, no other heavy run at the same time
limits: K15.14's: every router call (the load check and the route) under ulimit -v 8000000 (ROUTE_MEMORY_KB) and timeout -k 10 300 (ROUTE_TIMEOUT_S); every route with `--max-passes 2 --timeout 240` after the plugin's flags. A call that hits ROUTE_TIMEOUT_S or is killed by a signal (exit status 124 or above) is aborted = 1 and not graded. A route the router's own --timeout stopped (result manifest final_state TIMED_OUT) depends on the machine's speed, so its row is not judged (validity (b)). Estimated time: 34 calls. K15.14's amendment-3 run took about 38 min for its 38 calls (2026-10-21 23:24 to 2026-10-22 00:02, from the call logs' times): about 16 min for the 17 pcb-off calls and 14 min for the 17 pcb-on calls (its setting), 8 min for the 4 DSN calls. K15.25 measured the route with this setting on two rows: pcu 166.4 -> 179.0 s (final-unset, final-true, beside a test build) and 164.3 -> 161.4 s (v1-false, r2-true), canary-pwr 95.9 -> 108.0 s (final) and 93.3 -> 93.1 s (r2), so between -2 % and +13 %. Expected: about 32-36 min; the bound if every call hit ROUTE_TIMEOUT_S is 34 x about 330 s = 3.1 h

metric_definitions.via_in_pad: summary via_in_pad: tools/kicad-oracle/via_in_pad.py's vias_in_pads on the routed board minus the input board's, floored at 0 (D8)
metric_definitions.below_minimum: summary below_minimum: routed tracks and vias (whose nanometre copper key the input board does not have) under the Board Setup minimum track width, via diameter or via drill, summed
metric_definitions.manufacturing_breaches: summary manufacturing_breaches: the routing-caused KiCad DRC items (Q22.2's copper basis) of the types clearance, hole_clearance, hole_to_hole, copper_edge_clearance, track_width, via_diameter, annular_width, drill_out_of_range, solder_mask_bridge, shorting_items, summed
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: the signal: summary unconnected, kicad-cli's unconnected_items on the routed board after --refill-zones
metric_definitions.zone_zone_unconnected: secondary: the routed board's unconnected items (routed/drc.json, or the shared grade's) whose items are all zones: a pour split into islands that KiCad cannot join (K15.13's count)
metric_definitions.zone_zone_zones: the distinct (net, layer) zones those items name
metric_definitions.router_incomplete: the router's own incomplete connections at the end: the result manifest's board_statistics.connections.incomplete_count (work/<name>.result.json)
metric_definitions.kicad_less_router: secondary: kicad_unconnected - router_incomplete, how far KiCad's count is above the router's (K15.25 on pcu-76163c7: 36 off and 35 on; on canary-pwr-95882f00: 13 and 12)
metric_definitions.drc_real: guard (2): the sum of summary routing_caused_by_type (the grader's drc_real), every type
metric_definitions.route_seconds: guard (4): summary route_s, the routing call's wall-clock seconds
metric_definitions.connections: the result manifest's board_statistics.connections.maximum_count: the board's connections as the router loaded it, the default noise band's base
metric_definitions.input_unconnected: summary input_unconnected: kicad-cli's unconnected_items on the stripped input board

validity: checked before keep_rule, per row: (a) the setting reached the router: each pcb-on arm's result manifest (OUT/<row>/pcb-on/work/<stem>.result.json) has settings_snapshot.pour_fill_target true and no pcb-off arm's has it true (unset, so absent); a row whose pcb-on session is byte-identical to pcb-off's (summary grade_shared_with set) is judged as it is (the setting changed no route there) and named; (b) the row is judged when both its arms have aborted 0, graded true and final_state COMPLETED; (c) amendment 1 is written before the first arm and `cargo test -p freerouting-dev --test prereg_k15_30` passes in TREE. A row that fails (a) or (b), or whose board is missing, is left out of the judgement and reported by name with its reason; the keep rule, guards (2)-(4) and the set noise are then over the judged rows only. The measurement is 'not measured' (decision_table) only when fewer than min_boards (3) distinct rows are judged, pcu-76163c7 or canary-pwr-95882f00 is not judged (must_judge), or (c) fails
guards: (1) in every arm that runs and is graded, judged row or not: manufacturing_breaches = 0, below_minimum = 0 and via_in_pad = 0, absolutely (decided 2026-10-20: routing never breaks the board's manufacturing rules; routing-quality.md, order of importance items 1 and 2); the gate's HARD lines of the verdict pair and the reported pair, and summary.json for the rows left out. (2) routing-caused DRC not up: the sum of drc_real over the judged rows in pcb-on is at most pcb-off's. (3) no row worse than its own noise band (K15.14's guard, decided 2026-10-21): on every judged row, pcb-on's kicad_unconnected is at most pcb-off's + the row's band, the totals rule's per-row band (canary-pwr-95882f00 10, every other row max(2, ceil(5 % of its connections)), noise_why). (4) route time: the sum of route_seconds over the judged rows in pcb-on is at most 1.25 x pcb-off's
keep_rule: kept when validity holds (at least 3 distinct rows judged, pcu-76163c7 and canary-pwr-95882f00 among them, (c)), guard (1) holds, the signal improves (S: the sum of pcb-on's kicad_unconnected over the judged rows is lower than pcb-off's by more than the set noise sqrt(sum of the bands squared), noise_why; strictly more, as the gate computes it) and guards (2), (3) and (4) hold
keep_rule_by_hand: from OUT/records.json and OUT/table.md (`python3 -I TREE/tools/bench/k15_all_pours.py collect TREE/docs/roadmap/prereg/K15.30.json OUT`) and the gate (TREE's freerouting-dev, the commands of heavy_run's last step, with --prereg ROOT's docs/roadmap/prereg/K15.30.json as amended): `gate ... --baseline OUT/baseline.json --write-baseline`, then `gate ... --baseline OUT/baseline.json --all-pairs`, each with `--left-out ROW=REASON` for every row validity (b) leaves out (K15.21). The verdict pair's 'totals verdict' line is S, with the set noise it prints; its HARD lines and the reported pair's are guard (1); guards (2)-(4) are summed by hand from records.json; validity (a) from the result manifests and (b) from table.md's state column. The reverse pair is there for its HARD lines only; its totals verdict is the verdict pair's mirror and is not read

decision_table.not measured: fewer than min_boards (3) distinct rows judged, pcu-76163c7 or canary-pwr-95882f00 not judged, or validity (c) fails (a row left out by validity (a) or (b) does not by itself make the measurement 'not measured': it is reported by name and the other rows are judged): K15.30 stays [~] naming the rows and reasons; nothing changes in the product; the rows are run again only after the cause is fixed (a longer timeout_s or a fix), under an amendment naming it, with nothing else changed
decision_table.breach: the measurement is not 'not measured' and guard (1) fails in any graded arm (of a judged row or not): K15.30 stays [~] naming the arm, row and items; the breach is fixed in an item of its own (a pcb-on breach that pcb-off lacks is a defect of the setting; one in pcb-off is a defect of today's default), then the registered run repeats at the fixed commit under an amendment; until then `router.pour_fill_target` stays opt-in, unset in both profiles, and the plugin does not offer it (decided 2026-10-20: fix gains, don't remove them; never ship below-minimum copper)

known_effects: with the setting the search's ends on a .kicad_pcb signal pour lie where KiCad's refill fills, so fewer routed traces end in a strip the fill drops (K15.23's track_dangling), and the cycle rule keeps a trace into the fill that Java's removes. The router's own pour contacts stay Java's (BasicBoard::conduction_area_normal_contacts: every pin and via centred in the outline), so a pad in the outline where the fill does not reach still counts as joined: K15.25's extra pcu items (/CH2_NO U4 pad 8, /CH5_NO R11 pad 1) are of this kind, which K15.31 addresses with a setting of its own (not registered here). The setting changes the fanout too (K15.25: escaped pins 882 -> 884 on pcu). Both arms import the session whole, as the plugin does (fix_existing off), on stripped boards with no input copper. pocketsdr-v3-0's pcb-off arm hit the 240 s deadline in K15.14's run, so validity (b) may leave it out. The seen gains (pcu +2, canary-pwr -9, -7 on two rows) are far below the set noise (about 67 over 16 rows): S holds only if the other rows gain about 60 more
